Pain in back, thighs, elbows, shoulders.
Legs sore, as if bruised. *

soreness of inner nostrils (seventh day),*. — A feeling of itching and swell-
ing of mucous membrane of left nostril (fourteenth day),*. — Itching of nos-
trils (twelfth day),*.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
A few pimples on the face (fifth day),*. — Itching all over the
body, especially over the gluteal muscles and thighs, aggravated by warmth
of the bed (after three hours, third day),'. — Thighs itch (ninth day),*.

Sleep and Dreams. — Sleepiness. Yawning and stretehing,

Sleeplessness. — [70.] Restlessness, during the night (thirteenth ni^t),'.
